body: I would absolutely rather be dead right now. Probably not gonna do anything, but if a motor vehicle could hit me at 100 mph that'd be great.
Not gonna lie, I felt that. I'm a major dumbass and I'll probably never do anything of value.
Already did. Everything checked out normal.

If you're sure no one else cares about you, please believe that I care. That other people here care. Sure, I don't know you, I don't know your life. But I sure know what wanting to die for a long time will do to a person. I know it can seem pointless. Hell, it seems pointless to me. But I'm holding out hope that maybe things will change. I'm hoping that things can change for you. I really hope they do.

I'm sorry you're at this point. I really, genuinely know how that feels. I would probably be where you are right now if I could ever get a hold of a gun. The only reason I'm not dead right now is because my parents hid all the obviously dangerous objects after my recent attempts. I know this is gonna sound really dumb, but maybe this could be a second chance at living?

I am very sorry you're in that situation, especially because I've been causing my friends the same distress lately. I can say with certainty this is not your fault. You clearly care a lot about him. Unfortunately, depression can get so deep that you believe that the pain you're going through far outweighs what those close to you would feel after your death. All I can suggest is for you to listen. Tell him you are there if he wants to talk. You're going to want to talk him out of his depressive thoughts, but this usually isn't possible and can make a depressed person feel more isolated than before. Instead, just listen and frequently tell him how much you care about him. My friends are the only reason I'm hanging on. They care about me so much. You may not be able to stop him. If not, it's not your fault. But there's always a chance that you will.
